instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium-full shot, slightly high angle. In an indoor studio with a red carpet and white walls, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, facing right and smiling. The woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the right, facing him with her back to the camera. They stand close and hold hands under overhead artificial lighting.
